record: P4 namespace framing (resolves the P4-SYS vs P4-TRAIN collision)
problem: Prior records reference 'a separate P4 training authorization' while the proposed P4 workstreams (A-E) contain no training. One label, two meanings.

resolution.P4-SYS: System workstreams P4-A (structured generation), P4-B (verifier-guided generation), P4-C (ensemble), P4-D (real RTL expansion), P4-E (cost/latency optimization). Contains NO training, NO training authorization, NO training spend. This is the active P4.
resolution.P4-TRAIN: A hypothetical future training authorization, separate from P4-SYS in name, evidence, and sign-off. Does NOT exist. Comes into being, if ever, only via its own authorization after a READY verdict — never as a side effect of P4-SYS work.

rules: No P4-SYS artifact may authorize, fund, or perform training.
No P4-SYS result may be cited as training authorization.
If P4-TRAIN is ever proposed, it gets its own frozen spec, its own evidence, and its own human authorization; the P4-SYS record stays untouched.
Reviews and tests must fail any P4-SYS artifact that smuggles training scope (same guardrail family as P3-D).
